---

- If a specific game is not launching, crashing, or experiencing bugs, there's nothing I can do, as I'm not a Proton or GPU driver developer.
- Please make sure Faugus Launcher is up to date before reporting an issue.
- Please specify which distro you are using and whether you are using the native, Flatpak or AppImage version of Faugus Launcher.
- Please run `faugus-launcher` (native), `flatpak run io.github.Faugus.faugus-launcher` (Flatpak) or the AppImage file in a terminal and check if any errors appear when the issue occurs. If they do, include them in the report.
